title: PH dams see slight rises, dips in water levels

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Water levels in the country’s major dams recorded slight increases and decreases, according to data from the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). As of 8 a.m. on Monday, Oct. 19, six of the nine major dams monitored posted increases in water levels, while the remaining three recorded declines compared with measurements taken at 8 a.m. on Sunday, Oct. 18. Caliraya Dam in Laguna recorded the biggest increase, with its water level rising by 0.40 meter (m) to 286.70 m from 286.30 m.
